doc: Pixelate into square cells of `size` document px, aligned to the document origin (cell = floor(doc / size)). sample 'mean': average of the cell (premultiplied, n x n taps with n = min(size,16), regularly stride-subsampled above 16 px, deterministic; taps clamped into the document); 'centre': the colour of the pixel at the cell centre.
